16d1caeac2a7d8ab2470d56fe8231aaec0251c5d.summary: Rapid7 Labs analysis of a campaign that appears mostly directed at Pakistani targets. Attackers relied on spearphishing emails without exploits. The malware arrives as a .scr file and drops a Cabinet self-extractor plus a custom reverse-shell backdoor named ByeByeShell, which checks in to a command server and accepts operator commands. Decoy documents reuse Pakistani news articles. The operator was seen briefly searching files, but no clear origin could be determined. The campaign was assumed active for at least six months.
